fields.statement: At df9cc6f4, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(request-workflow-flag|describe-golden)$' passed. request-workflow-flag.txtar shows: request --workflow bugfix (a repo workflow) queued, and request ls --json with "workflow": "bugfix"; request --workflow nonesuch failing with 'no such workflow' and the queue unchanged ('No plan requests'). describe-golden now has the new workflow field on RequestRequest and RequestInfo. The script's `! exec` does not pin the exit code, so I checked by hand with a scratch build in a registered scratch project: --workflow nonesuch exits 2 with a usage error and queues nothing; --workflow plan (built in) queues, and ls shows [workflow plan]. In the diff, internal/api/request.go checks the name through lookupWorkflow (repo, personal and built-in layers) before queueing and stores it on daemon.Request.Workflow; run start already passes req.Workflow into newPlanChange (internal/api/run.go:569).
